newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - gasoline up, HSFO demand boosts.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gasoline up, HSFO demand boosts.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday, traders said.
Gasoline was $2-3 a tonne firmer on barges with strong NYMEX prices leading the market higher. An end July eurograde sold at $187.75.
Gas oil barge activity was muted by firmer futures and a strong dollar. Any inland German buying was covered by aggressive selling from local refiners, brokers said.
Prompt barge sellers still looked for August IPE +$1.50 but buyers were not to be found and brokers said premiums would need to come off.
Good supplies of Russian cargoes put pressure on premiums with some traders talking as low as evens with August IPE.
High sulphur fuel oil barges firmed to trade early at $88.50 then $88 fob ARA with traders citing better demand but others said the move to te upside was done for pricing purposes.
High sulphur Russian cargoes continued to fetch steady to higher prices as buyers kept coming into the market.
